User.title: User Profile
User.description: Represents a BarberSpace registered client profile

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication user ID

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents a haircut or grooming booking

id.description: The unique ID of the booking

userId.description: UID of the client who booked

serviceName.description: Name or combination of services of the booking

price.description: Cost of the booking in Brazilian Reais (R$)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this booking was created

SaaSConfig.title: SaaS Tenant Customization
SaaSConfig.description: Brand settings for the customized multi-tenant barbershop profile

id.description: The custom identifier for this barbershop tenant configuration (e.g., primary)

openHours.description: Display text of business working days and hours

SaaSFeedback.title: SaaS Platform Feedback
SaaSFeedback.description: Feedback provided by barbershop owners testing the platform demo

userEmail.description: Email of the partner who submitted the feedback

rating.description: SaaS platform usability rating on a scale from 1 to 5

likedMost.description: What they liked most about the software

missingFeatures.description: What feature they feel is most critical/missing

users/{userId}.description: Collection of user profile entries synced with Auth

appointments/{appointmentId}.description: Global list of all user barber bookings

saas_config/{configId}.description: Branding customization attributes loaded globally by clients and updated by owners

saas_feedbacks/{feedbackId}.description: List of SaaS test-trial feedback tickets submitted
